title: Linux 7.3 has significantly grown in size: Torvalds blames AI-generated contributions
content_md:
Linux 7.3 has significantly grown in size: Linus Torvalds blames AI-generated code contributions for the bloat. The kernel release has become notably larger than previous versions, with Torvalds attributing the increase to low-quality AI-generated patches being submitted to the kernel mailing list.

via Mastodon https://www.redhotcyber.com/post/linux-7-3-si-e-fortemente-ingrassato-torvalds-dice-che-e-tutta-colpa-delle-ai/
